verdict.summary: The round-1 major finding is resolved. The new tests use literal malformed inputs and literal expected diagnostics, cover multiple malformed types, verify survivor aggregates, silence on accepted and unmeasured rows, decision-22 privacy/fatality, bounded emission, and independence from the queue warning budget.
